name: NCF-SE 2023 — Mathematics, Middle Stage
description: Illustrative sample modelled on the National Curriculum Framework for School Education 2023 structure (Curricular Goals → Competencies → Learning Outcomes). Replace the statements with the exact text of your own policy document before using it in production.
subject: Mathematics

curricularGoals.statement: Understands numbers (whole numbers, integers, fractions, rational numbers), represents them, and performs operations on them fluently.

competencies.statement: Represents rational numbers on the number line and compares and orders them.
learningOutcomes: Locates positive and negative rational numbers on a number line.
Compares two rational numbers and justifies the comparison.

competencies.statement: Performs the four arithmetic operations on fractions and integers and applies them in context.
learningOutcomes: Adds and subtracts fractions with unlike denominators.
Solves word problems requiring multiplication or division of fractions.

curricularGoals.statement: Analyses patterns and represents relationships using variables, expressions, and simple equations.

competencies.statement: Generalises a numerical or geometric pattern using a variable expression.
learningOutcomes: Writes the nth term of a linear pattern as an algebraic expression.
Verifies a generalisation against specific cases of the pattern.

competencies.statement: Forms and solves linear equations in one variable arising from contextual situations.
learningOutcomes: Translates a word problem into a linear equation in one variable.
Solves a linear equation and interprets the solution in context.

curricularGoals.statement: Understands, describes, and reasons about shapes, their properties, and spatial relationships.

competencies.statement: Classifies two-dimensional shapes by their properties and justifies the classification.
learningOutcomes: Identifies quadrilaterals by side and angle properties.
Explains why a given figure does or does not belong to a class of shapes.

competencies.statement: Computes perimeter, area, and volume of standard figures and applies these in real contexts.
learningOutcomes: Calculates the area of composite rectilinear figures.
Estimates and checks measurement results for reasonableness.

curricularGoals.statement: Collects, organises, represents, and interprets data to answer questions and support claims.

competencies.statement: Represents a data set using an appropriate graphical form and justifies the choice.
learningOutcomes: Constructs bar graphs and pie charts from a given data set.
Explains why a chosen representation suits the question being asked.

competencies.statement: Interprets summary measures of a data set and draws defensible conclusions.
learningOutcomes: Computes mean, median, and mode for a small data set.
Identifies a claim that the data does not support.

name: NCF-SE 2023 — Science, Middle Stage
description: Illustrative sample of a second curriculum document, showing that several policies can coexist and be chosen independently in Competency Wizard Step 3.
subject: Science

curricularGoals.statement: Understands matter, its states, and the changes it undergoes in everyday phenomena.

competencies.statement: Distinguishes physical from chemical changes using observable evidence.
learningOutcomes: Classifies everyday changes as physical or chemical and justifies the classification.

curricularGoals.statement: Plans and carries out simple investigations and reasons from the evidence they produce.

competencies.statement: Designs a fair test by identifying variables to change, measure, and hold constant.
learningOutcomes: States a testable question and the variable being manipulated.
Explains why controlling a variable matters to the conclusion.
